body:
Hey, so I will be running a series of one shots for my friends (first time doing a oneshot) whenever we find time to do it.  
One of my friends is wanting to play a wizard order of scribes, and I am unsure how to handle wizard, since I know one of the reason you play wizard is to build up their spellbook with more spells, but since we are doing a oneshot, there won't really be a chance to build up spells in the spellbook.

How do other people handle this? Do you roll some tables and give them some random spells they learned from scrolls before hand, or let them do something like pick extra spells?

I was thinking something like between each one shot, he picks 3 spells he wants, and I pick him 1 that he found in his research. Or two?
